facts.condition: Assuming the inherited Theorem-9 converse is sound, a particular binary-auxiliary construction has a formally checkable dual witness that forces the target sum rate below 0.37.

assumptions: The inherited outer-bound theorem used by the accepted claim is valid for the canonical channel.
The accepted claim covers only the exhibited auxiliary construction and its dual witness.
No optimality of that auxiliary construction, matching achievable rate, or exact capacity value is assumed.
